recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-28207 unless EvidenceReport is reintroduced into core or the work group changes ownership of the EBM IG EvidenceReport profile.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes EvidenceVariable and Evidence, confirming the inspected StructureDefinition files are current build inputs. The current Clinical Reasoning evidence page says prior EvidenceReport Resource content has been replaced by an EvidenceReport Profile of Composition in the EBM IG. FHIR-28133 was a retracted predecessor request, and FHIR-29320 is separate Clinical Reasoning content work already represented on the combined branch.

The Clinical Reasoning module lists cqf-contactAddress, cqf-contactReference, and cqf-contributionTime.
